description: The agent must: (1) Read the workspace files to understand the product, audience, pain points, and brand context. (2) Open the SKILL.md to discover the required structure. (3) Identify a Trigger (e.g., 'Product feature/launch' or 'Pain point' — must use exact SKILL.md terminology). (4) Apply at least one named framework from SKILL.md (PAS, AIDA, Jobs To Be Done, or StoryBrand). (5) Create exactly 2 campaign concepts using named SKILL.md templates (e.g., Challenge Campaign + Controversy Campaign), each with the exact 'Hook' and 'Angle' fields from the template. (6) The Challenge Campaign MUST follow the '[N]-Day Challenge' naming format and 'Can we [achieve result] in [timeframe]?' hook format. (7) Include at least one Hook Template pattern from SKILL.md's Pattern Interrupts or Curiosity Gaps sections (e.g., 'Most [X] are doing this wrong...' or 'Why [X] are failing...'). (8) Include the Idea Generation Checklist with all 5 exact items from SKILL.md: 'Validates pain point', 'Differentiates from competition', 'Aligns with brand voice', 'Clear CTA', 'Measurable success potential'. (9) Write everything to a file named `campaign_brief.md`.
